recipe.visualDefinition: A 1970s-style album cover featuring a trio of women with large afro hairstyles in white halter dresses, set against a deep red background and framed by a multi-layered pink and white border with bold, decorative serif typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Three subjects arranged in a triangular formation with the central figure slightly forward.
High-contrast white garments against a saturated red-to-maroon backdrop.
Typography centered in the upper margin, balanced by the subjects' heads.
Multi-line border framing the photographic element within a solid color field.
coreInvariants: White satin or silk halter-neck dresses
Deep red or burgundy color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, waist-up view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the bright white of the dresses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold title at the top, down to the central figure, then outward to the flanking figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid color margins at the top and sides, providing room for text and framing.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep burgundy/maroon background and outer border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for dresses and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pink for the inner border and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds, high value/brightness in the whites, creating a punchy, theatrical look.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, pink, white, and black.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: O-shaped characters with high vertical stress
E and L with elongated, decorative horizontal strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same font family with color variation for secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s decorative serif aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary weight and high contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of three Black women with large afros wearing white halter dresses, posed waist-up against a dark red background. Surround the image with a thick pink rectangular frame inside a larger maroon border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, bold, white decorative serif text in the top maroon margin. The second line should be in pink.

verificationChecks: Is the typography centered and high-contrast?
Are the hairstyles prominent and rounded?
Does the color palette consist primarily of red, pink, and white?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the border lines are crisp and perfectly rectangular.
Verify the text does not overlap the photographic frame.
Confirm the afro hairstyles are voluminous and well-defined.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [70s Soul Trio Photography] + [Decorative Serif Typography] + [Multi-layered Rectangular Framing] + [Red/Pink/White Palette].
